x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.body: Given received stock, When an asset technician receives it into a stockroom, Then state is In stock with the correct substate Given an asset is deployed to a user, When the task completes, Then state is In use and assigned_to and location are set
x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.title: Hardware lifecycle is managed through stockrooms and OOB lifecycle states
